title: Design System: Mohamed Abdi Affey for Governor of Wajir County

display.purpose: The candidate's name and page titles. Prata 400.

title.purpose: Margin-column section labels (desktop only), footer column heads, office line.

label.purpose: Captions, units, stamp captions. Sentence case, no tracking; 13px floor.

figure.purpose: Countdown, years, amounts in tabular lining figures.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default ease for reveals, hovers, underline draws, header condense.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Stamp press, headline mask rise, menu sheet.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Underline draw, arrow step, nav underline, menu sheet.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals (20px rise + fade) and first-viewport entrances.

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: opacity 240ms + transform 520ms ease-out-expo, from rotate(tilt) scale(1.08)
motion.purpose: Entry stamps pressing onto the page, once.

motion.name: reveal-failsafe
motion.purpose: CSS shows all reveal content if JavaScript never hydrates.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation, transition, view transition and press scale is off.

textures.name: ink-grain
textures.purpose: Ink grain on stamp frames and figures; never on small caption text.

duotone.purpose: Every photograph on the site; provenance in a CREDITS.md beside the files.

narrative.overview:
The site is a passport laid open on the land of Wajir. A deep flag-green cover board holds sand-coloured pages; the pages carry a fine engraved guilloché ruling, ink type, and the candidate's record pressed onto them as rubber entry stamps in red and green ink. Every photograph, of the county and of the man, is printed in the cover's two inks, green and ochre, so the land and the candidate belong to the same document.

The world is flat and printed, not lit. Depth comes from the cover and the page, never from shadows: sand pages sit on green, and green bands interrupt sand. The type is a pairing of two voices: Prata, an engraved high-contrast serif, prints the name, headings, dates and figures; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, built for low-vision readers, carries everything people actually read, at 17px so it holds up outdoors on a small phone. Density is generous and editorial: wide section spacing, a margin column for section labels on desktop, a 40rem reading measure.

Motion is calm and happens once. Stamps press onto the page as they scroll into view, headline lines rise out of masks, land photographs settle. Nothing loops, everything uses transform and opacity, and all of it is gone under reduced motion. The first viewport never waits for JavaScript.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-green cover board, sand passport pages with guilloché ruling, ink text.
Rubber entry stamps (red or green ink, rotated a few degrees, ink-grain mask) as the signature mark.
Two typefaces only: Prata for display and figures, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text.
Every photograph a green/ochre duotone plate, set square into the page.
Flat surfaces: no shadows anywhere; depth is cover versus page.
Square-cornered controls, small book radius on pages, soft radius on stamps.
Tabular lining figures for every date, count and amount.

rules.name: The Colour Lock Rule
rules.body: Only the tokens in `src/styles/tokens.css`. Tints, shades and alpha variants of them may be derived; a new hue may not. Component code references tokens, never a raw colour value (the one exception is `themeColor` metadata, which cannot read CSS).

rules.name: The Red Ink Rule
rules.body: Flag red is for Donate and for stamps. It is never a decorative accent, a heading colour or a generic link colour.

rules.name: The Ochre Is For Figures Rule
rules.body: Ochre carries dates, counts and margin labels; ochre-700 on sand, ochre-300 on the cover. It is never body text.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Prata and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, nothing else. No monospace, not even for numbers or codes; figures are Prata or Atkinson with tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every `time` element and anything marked tabular uses `tabular-nums lining-nums`, and changing figures sit in fixed-width slots so nothing shifts.

rules.name: The Margin Label Rule
rules.body: A section's label lives in the desktop margin column, in Prata at title size, in ochre. On phones it is not shown. Nothing small, uppercase or tracked ever sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Printed Matter Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Pages lie on the cover, plates are set into the page, stamps are pressed onto it. If something needs separation, change the surface tone or draw a rule; never add a shadow.

dos: **Do** use only the tokens in `src/styles/tokens.css`; derive tints, shades or alpha from them when needed (ochre-700 is the precedent) and record the derivation beside the token.
**Do** reserve flag red for Donate and for stamps.
**Do** set the name, headings, dates and figures in Prata 400, and everything people read in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 17px or larger (small print floor 13px).
**Do** put section labels in the desktop margin column, in Prata at title size, ochre; hide them on phones.
**Do** print every photograph through `scripts/duotone.py land` (flag-green-deep to ochre-300) and record its provenance and licence in a CREDITS.md beside it.
**Do** animate only transform and opacity, once, with calm ease-out curves (160ms, 420ms, 640ms), and turn all of it off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep first-viewport content visible without JavaScript: entrances there run from CSS, and scroll reveals have a CSS failsafe that shows everything after 3.5s.
**Do** use tabular lining figures in fixed-width slots for dates, counts and money.
**Do** keep controls square-cornered (4px) with 44px minimum touch targets.
donts: **Don't** add a hue, a raw hex value in component code, or a gradient.
**Don't** use a third typeface or any monospace.
**Don't** place an eyebrow (a small, uppercase or tracked label) above a heading.
**Don't** use red for decoration, headings or ordinary links.
**Don't** show a full-colour or unprocessed photograph, or present the Wajir county photographs as campaign events.
**Don't** add box shadows, glows or floating cards; depth is cover versus page.
**Don't** loop, pulse or bounce anything, or animate layout properties.
**Don't** change locked copy to fit a layout; change the layout.
